about.title: About GLX Industries
about.subtitle: Pioneering Commercial Vehicle Engineering Since 2011
about.story: GLX Industries has established itself as Sri Lanka's leading commercial vehicle body builder. Operating across two state-of-the-art facilities in Ja-Ela and Kotugoda, we design and manufacture heavy-duty lorry bodies, insulated freezer boxes, food trucks, and light truck bodies. Every structure is engineered with high-tensile galvanized steel and coated with multi-layer 2K polyurethane paint for maximum durability.
about.mission: To engineer the most durable, reliable, and corrosion-resistant commercial vehicle bodies in Sri Lanka, empowering transport fleets and businesses with superior build quality.
about.vision: To remain Sri Lanka's premier automotive body builder through engineering innovation, computerized precision, and uncompromising craftsmanship.
